subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw support one process-wide external-discussion provider as a permanent plugin SDK and gateway contract, and if so what canonical agent-qualified session identity and plugin lifecycle semantics must it guarantee?
rationale: This PR adds a new exported SDK entrypoint and gateway methods; choosing whether the provider is process-global and how cross-agent sessions are identified is a durable product/API decision, not a mechanical review preference.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped generic seam
options.body: Keep the generic direction, but require an agent-qualified provider identity plus transactional registration/cleanup and focused compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep the integration plugin-local
options.body: Defer the core SDK and Control UI contract until a concrete plugin demonstrates a reusable requirement that existing plugin surfaces cannot meet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep the generic direction, but require an agent-qualified provider identity plus transactional registration/cleanup and focused compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author has supplied the complete proposed cross-surface contract and is the clearest available routing point for a maintainer decision on its intended shape.
